units.name: CO2 feed compressor
units.purpose: Pressurise fresh CO2 feed from battery limit to reactor loop pressure.

units.name: H2 feed compressor
units.purpose: Pressurise fresh hydrogen feed from battery limit to reactor loop pressure.

units.name: Feed mixer
units.purpose: Mix compressed fresh feeds with recycle gas to the reactor stoichiometric feed ratio.

units.name: Feed effluent heat exchanger
units.purpose: Recover hot reactor effluent sensible heat to preheat mixed reactor feed.

units.name: Trim feed heater
units.purpose: Add any remaining heat needed to reach catalyst inlet temperature during startup or low heat-recovery operation.

units.name: Methanation reactor
units.purpose: Cooled packed-bed catalytic reactor converting CO2 and H2 to methane and water; catalyst inventory is set by literature activity and conversion target is limited by equilibrium.

units.name: Reactor heat recovery
units.purpose: Remove the exothermic methanation heat from the reactor by generating steam from boiler feed water; thermal coupling to the reactor is represented in the model duty.

units.name: Product cooler condenser
units.purpose: Cool reacted gas below its dew point and condense liquid water produced by methanation.

units.name: Gas separation
units.purpose: Separate methane product from unreacted H2 and CO2 and carbon monoxide byproduct; recover unreacted reactants for recycle and reject a purge.

units.name: Recycle compressor
units.purpose: Restore pressure lost through the reactor, coolers and separator for the recycle gas.

units.name: Product compressor
units.purpose: Compress methane product from separation pressure to pipeline delivery pressure.

units.name: Utilities and offsites
units.purpose: Cooling water, steam system, controls, flare/vent handling and plant infrastructure supporting all process units.

catalyst_regeneration.excluded: Methanation catalysts in the screened literature are operated as reduced fixed-bed catalysts; no periodic oxidative regeneration chemistry is part of the continuous plant, so catalyst decay is represented by replacement and cycle-average activity rather than an in-situ regeneration unit.

diagram:
flowchart LR
  CO2[Fresh CO2] --> C1[CO2 feed compressor]
  H2[Fresh H2] --> C2[H2 feed compressor]
  C1 --> M[Feed mixer]
  C2 --> M
  RC[Recycle compressor] --> M
  M --> HX[Feed-effluent heat exchanger]
  HX --> TH[Trim feed heater]
  TH --> R[Methanation reactor]
  R --> HX
  BFW[Boiler feed water] --> WHB[Reactor heat recovery]
  WHB --> U[Utilities/offsites]
  HX --> KO[Product cooler condenser]
  KO --> SEP[Gas separation]
  KO --> W[Waste water]
  SEP --> RC
  SEP --> PC[Product compressor]
  PC --> P[Pipeline methane]
  SEP --> U
